title: PsychStrata CDSS
description:
Interactive dashboard enabling shared decision making for treatment resistance in depression.

The Psych-STRATA project has received funding from the European Union’s Horizon Europe research and innovation programme under grant agreement No 101057454.

Developed as part of the Psych-STRATA project: https://psych-strata.eu/

Disclaimer: This demo uses synthetic data for illustration purposes only. It is not a medical device and must not be used for clinical decisions.
